answer: The most recent server logs are in `server.log` inside the `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama` folder. The docs say: "_server.log_ contains the most recent server logs" [ollama/docs/windows.md]. To open the folder, press `Win+R` and run `explorer %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama`, which the same file describes as "`explorer %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama` contains logs, and downloaded updates" [ollama/docs/windows.md]. `%LOCALAPPDATA%` usually expands to `C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local`, so the full path is typically `C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local\Ollama\server.log`. That expansion is general Windows knowledge, not something the docs state.
